It writes the project's test inline: status hoh, and not (unmarried and a Test 1 person), and not (unmarried, home_cost and a Test 2 person). Its Test 2 count reads dependent.hoh_test2, which now excludes a person who counted an absence head of household does not count. The line is the gate that refuses a head of household return that fails the tests. The fresh reply writes the project's test inline (Test 1 count, or home_cost and Test 2 count, each compared as at least 1) but, unlike its fix-round-5 reply, drops the f1040.status test, so it is true on every return not filed as head of household whose filer does not meet the head of household tests, and it asks the head of household answers of every filer. It also drops the household.hoh_community_property refusal the project carries on household.hoh_eligible (amb.2025.hoh_community_property). executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/household.json`; 1,408 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 211 partial records; 2,119 comparisons): 562 of 2,119 agree; 1,408 value, 85 candidate-refuses, 62 candidate-unknown, 1 project-refuses, 1 project-unknown; on returns the full interview completes: 230 value, 14 candidate-unknown. Every completed-return difference was enumerated with the witness cap lifted (triage.mjs run directly; scratch /private/var/folders/kw/rp67pf8d5ng588lqp7d_gb240000gn/T/opencode/adj-t091-household/household.full.json; the uncapped rerun reproduces the recorded counts exactly): 230 value, project no and candidate yes, all on returns not filed as head of household (155 single, 48 joint, 27 qualifying surviving spouse; for example classm.s3.2.deepseek, classm.f4952.2.deepseek, classm.f8960.2.deepseek); 14 candidate-unknown, answers the project asks only on a head of household return: 6 partial records withholding household.home_cost and 4 withholding household.unmarried (for example classm.s3.4.deepseek, classm.f8880.2), and 4 dependent.born_died (classm.f8962.5 and .deepseek, generated 22 and 361). No completed head of household return differs, the T-091 fixtures included (t091.absence.hoh_refused: both refuse at dependent[child].hoh_absence, which the reply reaches through dependent.hoh_test2). Off completed returns: 1,178 value of the same kind; 85 candidate-refuses, dependent refusals reached on returns not filed as head of household (dependent claimed_no_tin, other_claimant, married, divorced_rule, multiple_support, income_exception; also dependent[child].hoh_absence on t091.absence.other_tests_unchanged, filed single, and dependent[parent].qr_kidnapped on t091.kidnapped.age18); 48 candidate-unknown of the same kind; the project-refuses is audit.household.hoh_community_property and the project-unknown is a partial record of classm.dependent.7.deepseek withholding household.community_property, both the dropped community property refusal. Project stands.

The candidate composed the project's own dependent.hoh_test1 and dependent.hoh_test2, so its review never tested them (the BUG-0146 gap); checked here against i1040gi p. 14 Tests 1 and 2 and p501 Table 4, they are right for persons alive all year, but their inputs default the death case: dependent.months tells the filer, for any non-qualifying-child person who died in 2025, to "enter 12 only if your home was their home for the entire time they were alive ... and 0 otherwise", and dependent.parent_home_paid asks about the parent's main home "for all of 2025". Witness (constructed from fixture stage8.hoh.parent.test1, evaluated by the engine): a dependent parent who died in 2025 after living with the filer for more than half but not all of her lifetime that year, filer paying over half the home cost (home_cost true, months 0 as instructed, parent_home_paid false): project household.hoh_fails true and Form 1040 line 12e refused ('Head of household is checked but the tests are not met'); Pub. 501 makes her a qualifying person, and with months 7 the same return computes line 12e $23,625.00.
